collection.description: A pale bird appears on Isola's coolest high ridge, and nobody agrees whether it belongs there.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A pale bird appears on Isola's coolest high ridge. Nobody can agree whether it belongs there.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: A careful sketch includes doubts about identification.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The trail ends in rock and fog; a second bird is not found.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A legend mentions white mountain birds but gives no firm answer.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: The bird disappears before anyone settles its identity.

text_only.reason: a bird flies off; no villager disappears
